source:
@@U00327@@
What’s your name?

@@U00329@@
Id call that a rather petty question,
especially from one with such contempt for words,
who scorns appearance
and digs down deep for the core of things.

@@U00331@@
The essence of the likes of you, sir,
can usually be read in their name,
Lord of the Flies, say,
or Destroyer, Liar.
It’s really quite transparent.
So, then, who are you?

@@U00333@@
A part of the Power that always wills evil,
but always works the good.

@@U00335@@
What is this riddle?

@@U00337@@
I’m the spirit that always negates!
And rightly so, since all that is
deserves to perish. How much better
if nothing ever existed. And therefore,
all that you call sin, destruction,
in a word, evil,
is my proper element.

@@U00339@@
A part, you say?
You call yourself a part,
and yet you stand there as whole as can be?
translation:
@@U00327@@
你叫什么名字？

@@U00329@@
我认为这是一个相当小问题，
尤其是来自一个如此蔑视言语的人，
谁蔑视外表
并深入挖掘事物的核心。

@@U00331@@
先生，像你这样的人的本质，
通常可以读到他们的名字，
蝇王说，
或毁灭者、骗子。
它确实非常透明。
那么，你是谁？

@@U00333@@
总是邪恶的力量的一部分，
但总是有好处的。

@@U00335@@
这是什么谜语？

@@U00337@@
我是永远否定的精神！
这是正确的，因为这一切都是
就该灭亡。好多少
如果什么都没有存在过。因此，
一切你称之为罪恶、毁灭的东西，
一句话，邪恶，
是我应有的元素。

@@U00339@@
你说一部分？
你称自己为一部分，
但你却尽可能完整地站在那里？
